warnings: This is a town Parks & Recreation department page, not a summer camp page. It has no summer camp program, dates, prices or ages.
The only programs listed are fall 2026 offerings (Fall II registration: yoga, pickleball, karate, tennis, Halloween events). None of them is a camp.
The '2027 Community Calendar' section is a photo contest and has nothing to do with a 2027 camp season.
The registration link is the town's general online payment portal, not a camp registration page.
